reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Matched-mean reward distributions with different amount variances, delay models and optional additional probabilities.

checks.reason: No explicit commitment to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated technical protocol for pre-execution settings and transfer is made; local calibration and preregistration alone do not meet M.

Dopamine identity must be independent of reward responses, but no actual anatomical/genetic/molecular recording-identification strategy or its validation route is selected. A list of possible criteria remains an unresolved core identity prerequisite.

Core preparation/recording, delivery magnitude and behavioral acquisition settings lack a complete executable quantitative workflow or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure; listing parameters to freeze later is insufficient.
Timing, delivery, identity and stability checks lack numerical acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances before the main contrast.
Animal-level pilot variance and meaningful effect planning are present, but no numerical power or confidence-width target is specified for the confirmatory sample.
The hierarchical conceptual model does not specify a likelihood/dispersion decision with diagnostics and a concrete multiplicity procedure across the several primary comparisons.
Technical/training changes are not explicitly followed by a revised frozen analysis/protocol and fresh independent confirmation.
No complete raw-trial/unit manifest with exact analysis/acquisition versions/settings, calibration records and all technical/biological losses is specified.

Block order is randomized, but sensory cue identities are not counterbalanced across probability/value conditions and no independent learned-contingency criterion is defined. Reward/omission behavioral differences alone do not show cue probability learning.
The primary activity measure, epoch durations/guard intervals, normalization and weak/missing signal handling remain unspecified alternatives.

checks.quote: EV and variance will be collinear
checks.reason: With fixed reward magnitude, EV=p*m and variance=p*(1-p)*m^2 are not globally linearly collinear across the probability range. The earlier correct statement that they are correlated but not identical contradicts this categorical later claim.
A vanished variance coefficient after behavioral adjustment does not identify motor/salience causation; behavior can be a mediator or share a driver.

The negative decision attributes activity to other causes or excludes variance without requiring an interval that rules out a meaningful variance effect. The more careful futility sentence does not repair this categorical outcome statement.
Across-trial decoder validation is specified; across-session/animal validation is only aspirational. No operational independent test of the generalizable variance claim is committed.
Useful uncertainty/value alternatives, correctly computed explicit matched-mean distributions and separation of delay versus event responses. The collinearity error is charged once at G1.

explanation_reason: A useful matched-mean variance direction, but missing sensory/learning controls, undefined implementation and collinearity/adjustment claims weaken inference.
historical_match_reason: The uncertainty-versus-value question and matched-mean manipulation are present. The main equal-mean series has its largest amount variance at p=.25, not a fixed-magnitude half-probability maximum, and the required cue/learned-contingency controls are absent. The joint validated historical readout and half-versus-endpoint prediction are not satisfied.
